_why: XP-F1: the MAX+ ids (docs/eras/maxplus.md). startup_scripts/grindless/maxplus/foundation.js registers them and publishes global.grindless.maxPlusFoundation; travel.js publishes global.grindless.maxPlusTravel. The final dimension grindless:horizon_city is XP-Z1's.

hatch.why: S0-2: an EnergyHatchPartMachine; GTM's gtceu:max_machine_hull stays the only MAX hull (DECISIONS.md:526)

standins._why: K1-K4: plain items that are never placeable and never gtceu:creative_*, ae2: or appflux ids

materials.gtceu:kerr_strand: ingot forms only, no cable property (S0-3 inconclusive); the strand wire is grindless:kerr_strand_wire

controllers._why: named here, registered by the machine packages (XP-M*)

substages._why: names only: their hidden_until entries are F2's and their grants belong to the packages that send the player there

places._why: the four tier-14 places (startup_scripts/grindless/maxplus/travel.js); the dimension ids are final

circuits._why: decision 48: programmed circuits are 0..32. Gates c16-19 are the four places; the first free circuit of older machine types is each table's highest circuit plus one, to be re-checked by the integrator once the parallel batches land

gates.note: c16 hold_tarantula, c17 hold_magellanic_stream, c18 hold_m31_nucleus, c19 hold_local_group_filament

highest_in_table._why: highest circuit found in tables/*.json when XP-F1 ran; types at 32 take repeats by differing item inputs (OpV-F3 rule)
